anchors.description: White single-gang toggle switch cover plate on the wall above the granite counter (the left plate of the visible pair); measured along its vertical centre line from the top edge to the bottom edge.
anchors.visible_evidence: Two identical white cover plates are clearly visible on the beige side wall. The left plate's bright region measures 21 x 33 px (aspect 1.57), matching the classic 2.75 x 4.5 in US single-gang plate ratio (1.64); points are placed on the top and bottom edges at mid-width.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard (2.75 x 4.5 in) vs oversized/jumbo (3.5 x 5.75 in) plate cannot be fully separated at this resolution, since both have the same aspect ratio; the interval brackets both interpretations.

anchors.description: Second white single-gang toggle switch cover plate to the right of a1, on the same wall; measured along its vertical centre line from top edge to bottom edge.
anchors.visible_evidence: The right plate's bright region measures 24 x 35 px (aspect about 1.46); its top and bottom edges are horizontal against the plain wall, and the points are on those edges at mid-width.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Same standard-vs-jumbo ambiguity as a1; the right plate is closer to the bright door frame, so its measured pixel extent has about +/-1 px extra uncertainty.
